column1: # Short monster names for MASTER.TXT @MONSTERS (applied by tools/build_patch.py after glossary apply).
# The game copies a monster's name into a fixed buffer, cut to 20 bytes (identified) or 14 bytes
# (unidentified, shown as ?name?). UTF-8 Japanese = 3 bytes per character, so identified names
# must be at most 6 characters and unidentified names at most 4.
# Every name field of a monster line that equals the long name is replaced. The long name stays
# the glossary translation used in dialogue and descriptions.
シヴァ・ハン・ゴロム
イライアス・コナカー
ジャック・ネファージュ
ノルロス・クノッソス

column3: Wizard ~ Worrfair (no ~: the game's glyph for ~ is unclear)
